sections.title: Integrity, quality *and thirty years of craft*

image.alt: Coleen Wallace, smiling, framed by pink phlox

body: C. Wallace Design was established in Aiken in 1995 and is built on a reputation for integrity and quality.

Coleen Wallace is a professional landscape architect licensed in South Carolina and Georgia, with more than 30 years of experience in residential and commercial landscape design, master planning, site design and streetscape design. She earned her bachelor of science in landscape architecture at Pennsylvania State University in 1987.

items.a: Yes. Along with commercial and municipal work, we design residential landscapes, gardens and renovations.

items.q: Can you draw plans that meet a tree ordinance?
items.a: Yes. Landscape plans that meet local tree ordinances are part of our landscape design work.
